item.title: HIGH SCHOOL BOYS’ BASKETBALL: John Klopfer reaches 1,000 career points as BH-BL tops Albany
item.description: BURNT HILLS, NY — Burnt Hills–Ballston Lake high school boys’ varsity basketball junior John Klopfer reached the 1,000-career-point milestone on Tuesday, Feb. 3rd, becoming only the fourth player in program history to achieve the mark and the only one to do so as a junior. Klopfer surpassed 1,000 career points with a put-back lay-up at the 3:08 mark of the fourth quarter during BH-BL’s 81-70 win over Albany High School.
